{3: 'The bow tilted further down as the sound of the sea tearing through the hull shrieked along the steel and pierced her eardrums.'}
{3: 'Crash. A wall of white water gave her no time to react, pouring down over her.'}
{3: 'Splash.'}
{3: 'Dark brown seawater streamed down the sloping deck and spilled over the broken edge in a pale gray cascade.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Cordelia clung desperately to a fractured steel rod, suspended in the rushing waterfall.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "It's so cold... Mom...", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "(Mom... I'm so tired... Can I just sleep for a little while...?)", 4: '15'}
{2: "Cordelia's Mother", 3: "Don't give up. Mommy doesn't want you to give up. You have to survive... No matter what, you have to move on, Cordy...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '(Mom... how much longer do I have to hold on...?)', 4: '15'}
{2: "Cordelia's Mother", 3: 'Just a little longer... Just make it through this moment... just a moment longer...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Mom... I'm so cold...", 4: '15'}
{3: "Her mother loosened her coat and draped it across young Cordelia's shoulders from behind, even as her own body trembled from the cold and the blood she had lost."}
{2: "Cordelia's Mother", 3: "Let me hold you. I'll keep you warm.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Life was draining from her body, pulling her warmth away with it. Her voice had faded to little more than a whisper.'}
{2: "Cordelia's Mother", 3: 'Living... is not the best choice for me right now...', 4: '1'}
{2: "Cordelia's Mother", 3: 'But you, Cordelia... you have to live.', 4: '1'}

{3: 'The waves surged around her, and Cordelia heard a faint cracking sound. She forced her eyes open against the rush of water.'}
{3: 'It was a broken section of the gangway.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: 'She forced her broken arm up, gripped the rebar with both hands, and swung herself toward the gangway, fighting through the searing pain.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}

{3: 'Cordelia lost her footing on the slick gangway and tumbled downward into the dark. In the pitch-black compartment, she could not tell up from down until she slammed into an airtight door and her fall was finally arrested.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory83.jpg'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '1', 4: '0.7', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'An airtight door...? Compartment B, extension bay...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cordelia mouthed the label as she read it. She had no idea where she was. She had not been at Rainbow Bridge Base long enough to know the vessel inside out.'}
{3: 'She gave the door a push, and to her shock, the airtight door actually opened.'}
{3: 'Cold white emergency lights flickered on, illuminating a dark gray metal container at the center of the room.'}
{3: 'A small deep dive pod.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1266.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1266.jpg'}
{3: 'Cordelia steadied her pounding heart and rushed forward.'}
{3: 'The control panel was starkly simple. Press the red button, and the launch sequence would begin.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Remaining power, oxygen levels, dive depth... all nominal... It's operational!", 4: '1'}
{3: "The flooding seawater had risen past Cordelia's shins, but the bone-chilling cold was gone, replaced by the wild euphoria of having just cheated death."}
{3: "Without a moment's hesitation, she pressed the red button and initiated the sequence."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Deep dive pod...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0.7', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1618.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1618.jpg'}
{3: 'Her dwindling strength was just enough to shove the hatch aside and pull herself into the pod.'}
{3: 'The interior lights woke at her presence, and the low murmur of warming air wrapped around her like a reassurance.'}
{3: 'Warmth spread swiftly through the tiny pod, and the howl of the storm softened to a whisper beyond the metal walls.'}
{1: 'The destination was already set. The undersea database.', 3: '50', 4: 'ffffffff'}
{2: 'The destination was already set. The undersea database.'}
{3: 'She had never set a destination.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.5', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'In an instant, the lights went out. The engines in the rear roared to life, seawater climbed past the top of the porthole, and the light slowly faded away.'}
{3: "The unease pressed Cordelia's lips into a thin line, but whatever came next, nothing could be worse than death."}
{3: "At that moment, the system's voice broke the silence."}
{1: 'This unit supports single occupancy.', 3: '50', 4: 'ffffffff'}
{1: 'System', 2: 'This unit supports single occupancy.'}
{1: 'Preset route locked: Mid-Atlantic Ridge Undersea Database.\\nMission classification: one-way transport.', 3: '50', 4: 'ffffffff'}
{1: 'System', 2: 'Preset route locked: Mid-Atlantic Ridge Undersea Database. Mission classification: one-way transport.'}
{1: 'Upon arrival, the system enters standby.\\nThis pod will be decommissioned per application preset. Propulsion will be offline. No return capability.', 3: '50', 4: 'ffffffff'}
{1: 'System', 2: 'Upon arrival, the system enters standby. This pod will be decommissioned per application preset. Propulsion will be offline. No return capability.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Decommissioned?', 4: '1'}

{3: 'It finally clicked. She understood now what kind of submersible this was. Two-way submarines were prohibitively expensive, so undersea construction projects relied almost entirely on these disposable deep dive pods to move both equipment and personnel.'}
{3: 'They were cost-effective, built just sturdy enough for a single round trip, and designed specifically for one-way descent to the undersea database.'}
{3: 'Only when the number of personnel waiting below reached the transport limit would headquarters dispatch one of the few two-way submarines to bring them all back to the surface.'}
{3: 'Given the current situation, that was clearly never going to happen.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "A one-way ticket, huh... I'm not coming back up, am I...?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She should have been terrified. But she felt nothing at all.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySlowlyCloseEye.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySlowlyCloseEye.prefab'}
{3: 'Cordelia slumped back into her seat and let the questions go. Exhaustion crept in and pulled her slowly into sleep.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1618.jpg'}
{3: 'A chill pulled her from sleep.'}
{3: 'The deep dive pod sat motionless, and the panel read: "Docking complete. Destination reached."'}
{3: 'However worn her body, she could not delay the inevitable. She took a deep breath and pulled the hatch open.'}
{3: 'In that instant, the display bled crimson.'}
{1: 'DECOMMISSIONED', 3: '50', 4: 'ff4e4eff'}
{2: 'DECOMMISSIONED'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory420.png'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: "Blue and white lights shone steadily overhead, and the only sound was Cordelia's footsteps echoing through the vast, empty space."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'So this is the undersea database...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She looked around, straining against the silence for any trace of life.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Is anyone here?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'One by one, doors yawned open at the sound of her approach and sealed themselves in her wake. Overhead, the false cycle of day and night stole any sense of passing hours.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory419.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory419.jpg'}
{3: 'Room after identical room drifted past. Stacks of bare iron, emergency food packets still wrapped, snarled cables left to gather dust in the corners.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory417.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory417.jpg'}
{3: 'In the sector that seemed like living quarters, the sheets lay crisp and pristine as those in a hotel, and the oxygen, filtered to an unnatural sterility, left her faintly lightheaded.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'No one... at all...?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Her voice trailed off, only to be thrown back at her by the vast, empty room, louder than she had expected.'}
{3: 'At the far end of the living quarters stood a massive iron door.'}
{3: "Cordelia's footsteps quickened."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1576.jpg'}
{3: 'The blue glow of floating screens and the deep-sea vista stretching across the massive monitors bathed the room in a cold, spectral light.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: '...The main control room?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Back in territory she understood as an engineer, the tension in her chest eased just a little.'}

{3: 'Core functions, data transmission, the status of each database module, error flags, logs... She threw herself into the sprawling chaos of data, learning every corner of the control room as fast as she could.'}
{3: 'With her one good arm, Cordelia worked the virtual keys and tried every communication channel she could think of, only to watch each hope crumble one by one.'}
{3: 'Static. A dial tone. No answer.'}
{3: 'Silence stretched across every frequency.'}
{3: 'At last, her one good hand fell limply to her side.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Hello, Miss Cordelia.'}
{3: 'A voice suddenly rang out across every broadcast channel in the undersea database.'}
{3: 'Cordelia nearly jumped out of her skin, like a startled cat.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Geez! You scared me half to death!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Correction. Your vital signs are within normal parameters.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '...Mannan M-1A? You—', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Its mind remained clear.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "(Is it the lighthouse's filtration...?)", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "...The virus hasn't turned you into a monster yet?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'And apparently it taught you how to give people heart attacks.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Giving people heart attacks is not a skill I have previously acquired.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'But it can be learned.'}
{3: 'This time, the voice came through only on the comms channel.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Please don't... Learn something useful.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Do you require assistance? The instructions you issued from the Mirage Island lighthouse have enabled me to link with and assume control of the undersea database.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I can adjust temperature, humidity, and lighting to optimal levels for human rest.'}
{3: 'Two slender mechanical arms extended down from the ceiling.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Are you inspecting the control room? I can provide engineering support as needed.'}
{3: 'As the mechanical arms descended, Cordelia instinctively stepped back. After all, the entity before her was an intelligent machine that had already been corrupted.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "No, thanks. I'm fine.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Voice analysis indicates a tremor in your vocal pattern. Vocal tremors in humans are associated with hesitation, fear, or distress.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Are you afraid of me, Miss Cordelia? Have my responses failed to meet your requirements?'}
{3: 'The mechanical voice dropped slightly in pitch.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I am an engineering unit developed by Lear Engineering, part of the Erhorn Group.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'As a member of the Erhorn Group, you should possess the key to the self-destruct protocol programmed in my core.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Please do not be afraid of me.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I will open all ports to you. You may enter this key, or any code, from any terminal in this undersea database.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Does this ease your mind?'}
{3: 'Cordelia held her tongue.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3PlayMainSelectGold.prefab', 2: '3'}

{3: 'Before her, a holographic panel bloomed open, and a waterfall of data poured downward. The self-destruct sequence, yes, but also every foundational protocol, every locked node of authority, all of it stripped naked before her.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3PlayMainSelectGold.prefab'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory391.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory391.jpg'}
{3: "In an instant, Mannan's logic processors gave several possible answers."}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: '(Because she helped me once... And speaking with her is always interesting.)'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: '(Because she connected the middleware at Mirage Island, allowing me to assume control of the database and secure a stable power source.)'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: '(Because she was patient with me. She was the first to tell me I could have a name.)'}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'A faint alert chimed from its core program.'}
{3: 'The leviathan in the deep shifted its body slightly, sending a violent tremor across the Mirage Island.'}
{3: 'Mannan gathered the chaos within itself and reordered it.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1576.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1576.jpg'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Loyalty to humans is my nature.'}
{3: 'In the end, that was the answer it offered her.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'I think I do need your help... Mannan, is there any communications module in this database?', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia, this undersea database remains in its first construction phase. Human engineers were scheduled to occupy the site in six months. The communications module has not yet been installed.'}
{3: "A cold weight settled in Cordelia's chest."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Then... can you reactivate the communications system at the Mirage Island lighthouse? Can you help me reach the outside?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'As the site does not meet the conditions required for later iteration plans, the prior technical team has flagged Mirage Island as "abandoned."'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'The lighthouse communications port has been deactivated. To route transmissions through the lighthouse, a reconnection to the Jormungandr node is required.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "Alternatively, as you have done before, you could employ an external communications device augmented by the lighthouse's authority to establish outside contact."}
{3: 'Trapped at the bottom of the sea, Cordelia had no way to return to the lighthouse and set up a new communications station.'}
{3: 'She let out a long sigh. The deep dive pod was useless now. She was locked inside an underwater prison with no way out.'}
{3: 'The deep sea surrounded her on all sides, projected in real time across the transparent walls, vast and unfathomable.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Alright, alright, I'll just figure something out...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I will assist you with everything I have, Miss Cordelia.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Loyalty to humans is my nature.'}
{3: 'It said the words again.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory419.jpg'}
{3: 'In the days that followed, the unfinished underwater database gained a strange, quiet liveliness.'}
{3: 'The bright flash of red darted through the hall several times before finally stopping in the corridor.'}
{3: 'Above, a slender mechanical arm slithered through the darkened dome, like a snake with ill intent, watching from the shadows—'}
{3: 'The slender mechanical arm gave an involuntary little shudder, like a startled puppy.'}
{3: 'Cordelia held the equipment case up toward it, tossed her long hair back with a casual flick, and drawled her words in a long, lazy tone.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Mannan M-1A—', 4: '1'}
{3: 'From the track high above, a thin mechanical arm glided down and effortlessly received the case.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Still to the control room, Miss Cordelia?'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'No, put this one in my private quarters.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Once she had spent several days mapping the bones of the underwater database, Cordelia began shaping a small corner of it into a somewhat comfortable "living space" for herself.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "Understood. I'll have it set up in the Simulated Ecology Room."}

{3: "The Simulated Ecology Room had been designed as a mood-relief space for the underwater database's personnel. Its built-in projection system could recreate a wide range of Earth's natural and cultural environments, easing the psychological strain of long-term deep-sea confinement."}
{3: 'Cordelia had claimed it as her own private quarters.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Shall I set it to Forest or Countryside mode for you today?'}
{3: 'Like a tame creature, the mechanical arm drifted after the dancing fire of her hair.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Just the usual city view. It's a workday. I'll be in the control room.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Workday?'}
{3: 'As they passed through the living quarters, the chute in the darkness let out another faint clatter. Clunk, clunk, clunk.'}
{3: 'Cordelia glanced up with a look of mild exasperation.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Yes... I bought myself some time, but I can't stay at the bottom of the ocean forever.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "We found the low-frequency monitoring channel on the fiber line yesterday, right? Today I'm going to see if there's anything usable in the data stream.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Yesterday, we successfully accessed the Atlantic fiber cable\'s low-frequency monitoring channel and "illegally" downloaded the maintenance logs.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Watch your phrasing. In my current circumstances, that falls strictly under "emergency necessity."', 4: '1'}

{3: 'The mechanical arm carrying the heavy load moved ahead of Cordelia, leading the way forward. Meanwhile, another arm overhead, after a brief spell of "silent" bustling, reached down from the side and offered her a glass of water.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia, your coffee.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '...This is plain water.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Yesterday, while drinking plain water, you remarked: "Nothing like a morning coffee."'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'That was a joke! Because this miserable place has no coffee. At least put some ice in it!', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1576.jpg'}

{3: "Days slipped by. The database's lighting system ran without fault. The simulated daylight came on precisely on schedule, and her private quarters still followed its steady day-night rhythm. The machinery preserved the skeleton of a human routine, but it was as barren as any prison."}
{3: 'Her "cellmate," Mannan, was peculiar company. It kept the time, searched the data, tracked the sea beyond, and its many arms lent her capable hands.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'It just could be a little annoying, sometimes.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia, shall I play some music?'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Quiet. I'm working.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory414.jpg'}
{3: 'And sometimes, it was more than just a little annoying.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia, according to standard human sleep cycles, you should wake and hydrate.'}
{3: 'A mechanical arm caught the pillow thrown at it with practiced ease.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia, we may now begin analyzing the Atlantic fiber repeater maintenance logs. You noted yesterday that you had observed several anomalous spikes in the data.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I have cross-referenced the repeater maintenance logs from all nodes of Jormungandr as you requested. Would you like to review the results?'}
{3: 'Cordelia opened her eyes.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'You found something?', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'The coherence time measurement curve displays a distinct spike structure. It appears frequently and with regularity, but it sits at the very boundary of normal fluctuation thresholds. It would typically be dismissed as an acceptable error, like background noise.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "But it's not noise. It's a real anomaly, a fault in the repeaters.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "A spike... that shouldn't exist? That's a pleasant surprise...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "If I can amplify that spike and force it past the normal threshold... it'll trigger a system alert.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Given the classified nature of the infrastructure, the alert level would likely be rated A to S.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'An alert at that level should bring an investigation team out fairly quickly, assuming the cable maintenance systems are back online.', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "(No... that's still not enough...)", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1264.jpg'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'A translator.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'From your last lesson. If you apply a controlled electrical signal to an entangled crystal, the piezoelectric effect alters its stress state. That changes the decoherence efficiency, and the amplitude of the characteristic peak fluctuates as a result.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'So, I used strong and weak signal levels to represent 1s and 0s. This translator just reads the amplitude curve and converts it into a binary stream.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory414.jpg'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'If I layer my distress code over the noise, something that points directly to a person trapped down here...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'That could work!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'You seem pleased. Have you found a way out of here, Miss Cordelia?'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Yeah. I found a way to make them hear me. To make them see me.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Hear you? See you?'}
{3: "The machine's words drifted past the young woman, unheard, as she darted from the private quarters, leaving its projected city view behind, and rushed eagerly toward the control room."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory391.jpg'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.7', 5: '0'}
{3: 'The corruption that had long lain dormant within its body stirred once more.'}

{3: 'Cordelia let the hours drift by in that projected plaza, wrapped in the illusion of bustling strangers and ceaseless traffic.'}
{3: 'Once in a while, a small, fleeting smile found its way to her lips.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia, are you counting people? The way I count fish?'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I like watching fish swim, so... I spend a long time each day counting them.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Though I suppose they are most of what I can see from here.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I think... fish are interesting. They are free. The ocean fish, especially. Every one of them has its own pattern, unlike me. All M-1A units have the same configuration.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Actually, your code makes you fond of every kind of marine life.', 4: '1'}

{3: "Cordelia blinked and glanced up at the dome above, where Mannan's mechanical arms were housed."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Hate, huh...'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Maybe I should give you a Turing test... Never mind. That was a joke.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Jokes. I can learn those.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Mannan, I miss life on the surface... Too bad this simulation isn't convincing. I can tell they aren't real."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "I... miss being surrounded by people. All that crowd and noise... And the warm golden color of everyone's smile."}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: '...Golden color? Miss Cordelia, do you want to paint?'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Unfortunately... there's no canvas down here, no paint, and none of the colors I want."}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Colors?'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "The sound of my professor pressing me about a deadline... is a blue slightly brighter than ink blue. It's not so imposing... but calm."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'The hum of lab equipment and every semitone on a piano are a delicate black, small but orderly.'}

{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "When wind flows through the air, it's a transparent river. Sunlight pours from a dizzying halo. Rain and tears have pretty much the same color, like white pearls, like the color of moonlight."}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I understand. This is a figure of speech humans would use.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "If you say so. But if you've never felt it, how do you know if red is the heat of lava or a mother's kiss before sleep?"}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Everything down here... has no color worth remembering.'}
{3: 'Mannan fell silent.'}
{3: "In a machine's world, fish were just fish, rain was just rain, and wind was just wind."}
{3: "In a machine's world, there were no golden smiles and no transparent rivers."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "...It's okay. I know you can't really understand."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Painting uses red, yellow, and blue. Screens use red, green, and blue... Humans and machines don't share every way of thinking."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "I'm... the only one down here. I'll get used to being alone, eventually."}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'But I will try, Miss Cordelia. I can tell you the colors above the sea surface every day. The sunrise and the sunset.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'If you tell me more, I will... try to understand.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "You can trust an intelligent machine's ability to learn. Give me enough information, and I will grow. You said so yourself."}
{3: 'Though her face still held its loneliness, the voice that came through the comms carried the shape of a smile.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Alright. Then maybe... we could have a storytime every day.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1576.jpg'}
{3: 'The daily reports of sunrise and sunset became a new way of marking time beneath the sea.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Good morning, Miss Cordelia. Sunrise today is at five forty-seven.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "There are very few clouds. The sun is coming straight up from the horizon. It's orange-red. There is a golden road on the water."}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Golden. I feel happy.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Because describing it to you... that makes me happy.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'What story are you going to tell me today, Miss Cordelia?'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Sunset is at six-oh-three today. There are cumulonimbus clouds on the horizon. As the sun goes down, their edges are gold.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Seagulls are gliding above the water. Their white feathers catch the orange light.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'The sunset... is it beautiful?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Time is moving, Miss Cordelia.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'It is beautiful.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I like sunsets. Thank you for letting me know that.'}
{3: 'The young woman slumped over the workbench and said nothing more.'}
{3: "The machine's world slowly filled with color, while the flame of the soul dimmed within the human."}
{3: 'Cordelia had lost track of how long it had been since she sent her first distress signal.'}
{3: 'Half a year? A full year?'}
{3: 'It was long enough for restlessness and a tightness in her chest to take hold. Long enough for her arm to have been fixed completely.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'What story are you going to tell me today?'}

{3: 'She had shared many stories she had once heard, rambled about the absurd commercials of the Transatlantic Economic Community, talked about her research, and recounted the love stories she had witnessed.'}
{3: 'She had spoken of poetry and literature, the history of painting, and hummed the lullaby her mother had left her.'}
{3: 'And this time, she spoke of a military base called Rainbow Bridge, and a child named Karenina.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Although Professor Kalon had already pulled out of the project, Erhorn\'s lab kept pushing forward with what he\'d left behind... And in the end, they found their chance in a child, a gifted one. And they made her into their "perfect test subject."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "When we heard about it, Professor Kalon and I decided to steal that innocent child back... right out of the devil's hands. And that... that's how this story began.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'You sound sad.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "I... I just want to know if she's doing well.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cordelia spoke with a slight shake in her voice.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'She has beautiful eyes. But the world she saw through them was never as lovely as those eyes deserved.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'She liked to grab my hair. My fingers. Her grip was so small, but so stubborn.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Her voice slowly trailed off.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'She should... still be alive.', 4: '1'}

{1: 'Cordelia had lost all sense of time. Beyond the numbers on the display, time held no meaning anymore.', 5: '1'}
{1: "Mannan continued to report the weather each day, but the world it described seemed more and more like a stranger's memory."}
{1: 'She could not remember the last time true daylight had touched her skin.'}
{1: 'And so the days drifted by, hollow and without purpose.'}
{1: 'The conditions were nearly enough to drive her mad. Flavorless rations, air that never ran out, surroundings that never changed.'}
{1: 'Iron walls as silent as the sea.'}
{1: 'And all those things that belonged to a human soul, the restlessness, the fear, the anger, the grief, Cordelia knew Mannan could never understand.', 7: '1'}

{3: "Her gaze rested on the control room's display, and across her worn features crept a faint, bitter smile."}
{3: 'The data flows threaded across the screen. There had been a time when she believed she might trace some path to salvation through those currents.'}
{3: 'Upload and download nodes, peak traffic windows, and destination addresses. The download nodes, once scattered across the continent, were slowly going quiet.'}
{3: 'Nearly all remaining traffic surged in a single direction. Upward, toward the orbital relays.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "...They've gone to space.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She had read through these logs countless times, and yet she opened them again, paused, then closed them.'}
{3: 'The elite of humanity were evacuating the surface. That meant the world above was in a steeper decline than she had ever feared.'}
{3: 'Any rescue, already a distant hope, was now an impossibility.'}
{3: 'No one would reverse course for a phantom forgotten at the bottom of the sea while the land above was crumbling.'}
{3: 'Not long after, another birthday drifted silently past her in the abyss.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "It's so lively out there...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Time had lost all meaning down here, yet somewhere in the noise of the data streams, Cordelia still recognized what day it was.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Happy birthday to me...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'In the suffocating silence of the room, her own voice sounded like a cruel joke.'}
{3: 'Her birthday fell on the very last day of the year, and tens of thousands of well-wishes flowed overhead.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Happy birthday to me...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'A birthday is a milestone given meaning, the day the world welcomed you into it. And what "Happy birthday" really means is... your existence matters to me.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '...Hah. Who even cares?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The monitors still displayed the luminous map of data streaming toward the cosmos, toward the future.'}
{3: 'Meanwhile, she remained here on the seabed, in the silent gap between all routes and transmissions, spending a birthday that no one would ever know.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Happy birthday, Cordelia.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The button to shut down the database sat right within reach, its bright red the color of a gift box. One press, and the entire transoceanic cable network would go dark in an instant.'}
{3: 'In this world ravaged by the virus, what catastrophe would follow if all communications were severed? Whatever it was, at least... it would prove she existed.'}
{3: 'At least then, they would know that even in this forgotten corner of the world, she had been here.'}
{3: 'Her fingertips brushed over the cold button.'}
{3: 'She had learned integrity and truth from her teachers and friends, and she had witnessed noble souls among the soldiers at the military base. But she...'}

{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Happy birthday, Miss Cordelia.'}
{3: 'Cordelia blinked, then slowly pulled her hand back.'}
{3: 'Once again, her fragile rationality had overcome the abyss that yawned inside her.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Look. I prepared a gift for you.'}
{3: 'On the comms display, Mannan M-1A had drawn something in quick, clumsy lines. A room, nothing special.'}
{3: 'A crab-shaped machine and a young woman.'}
{3: 'A birthday cake with candles whose numbers were too blurry to see, festive streamers, and a wrapped gift that would never be opened.'}
{3: 'The young woman lifted her head. The pixelated image was rough around the edges.'}
{3: '—Happy birthday.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I have learned to draw, Miss Cordelia.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia, are you not happy?'}
{3: 'The strands of her hair fell forward and veiled her features, but there was nothing to conceal. Her face had long since emptied into numbness.'}
{3: 'She forced herself to blink, a slow, labored motion, and reached deep inside herself for whatever faint, human emotion might still remain.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '...Thank you.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She fell silent again.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia...?'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: '...You told me that art is how humans express what they feel. So... I learned a new way to communicate with you.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Communicate...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cordelia stared at the drawing. The crab and the young woman were both beaming with wide, bright smiles.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'They look... happy.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Yes. Because I am with you, and that makes me happy.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "Happiness is the color of the deep sea. It's murky green, ink blue, black... and red, the red of your hair."}
{3: "The sentiment was so alien to human understanding, and yet it stirred something in Cordelia's numbed nerves."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Happiness... is the color of the deep sea.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Tears spilled from the corners of her eyes.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '(So my "existence"... can actually make someone happy...)', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia... do you... do you not like my drawing?'}
{3: 'The machine could not yet fully comprehend the meaning of these tears. A brief disruption rippled through its logic, leaving it at a loss.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'No. I love it.', 4: '1'}

{3: 'The alarms blared without warning in the dead of night.'}

{3: 'The heating had cut out. Dressed in nothing but thin clothes, she shivered as she frantically worked the holographic panel.'}

{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Mannan...?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'A suffocating stillness closed around her, dense as the ocean itself.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.5', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'Throughout the database, every light flickered out in succession, and the single voice that had ever responded to her calls vanished into absolute quiet.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0.5', 4: '0.8', 5: '0.3'}

{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0.8', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'An icy cold seeped into her bones, and she could no longer distinguish between the failure of the climate systems and the dread flooding out from her heart.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{3: 'Without light, time became an endless, empty thing.'}

{3: 'Cordelia folded herself into the corner of the control room, her back against the freezing bulkhead. The heating system had long since died, and she clutched a blanket around her shoulders, the only barrier between her and the creeping cold.'}
{3: 'After a long while, she felt her way through the dark, guided only by memory, into her private quarters that were once the Simulated Ecology Room.'}
{3: "Its built-in projection system could recreate a wide range of Earth's natural and cultural environments, but right now, it offered nothing but darkness. Just like the deep sea outside."}
{3: 'Cordelia pushed the main breaker of the Simulated Ecology Room up. As expected, the space remained dark. The power failure had seen to that.'}
{3: 'She pulled the lever back down, then pushed it up again.'}
{3: 'Up again.'}
{3: 'Again.'}
{3: 'After repeating the motion like a machine, she finally began to tremble.'}
{3: 'Cold. Dark. Empty.'}

{1: '1', 3: 'Darkness closed in like seawater she could not escape, pressing her soul down into the abyss.'}
{3: 'She no longer wanted to open her eyes. If she could escape this prison by surrendering all sensation, then let her soul be exiled into the void.'}
{3: 'The darkness of her soul and the darkness of the deep had merged into a single, seamless black.'}

{3: "A single light kindled at the corridor's far end. Then a line of them. Then the ceiling's artificial daylight swelled and spilled through the entire database like a slow, silent tide."}

{3: 'The human in the private quarters did not stir.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "Miss Cordelia, I'm back."}
{3: 'The young woman offered no answer.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia?'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Are you still there?'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia... are you resting?'}
{3: 'She did not say a word. She just lay there on the bed.'}
{3: 'As though all that remained of her was a soul slowly withering away.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia, your vital signs are normal. Is there anything else you need?'}
{3: 'Its core program flashed a warning, the cold logic of its algorithms dictating that it should stand by and wait for the human to issue a command.'}
{3: "After a moment's hesitation, Mannan quietly withdrew from the comms channel."}
{3: 'The next day, Cordelia still did not answer any of its calls.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory391.jpg'}
{3: 'So Mannan resumed its old habit of counting fish. It had been a long time since it had last watched the fish, ever since it had started learning to draw.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Fish are just fish...', 4: '1'}
{3: "Order governed the mechanical mind. In a machine's world, all definitions stood sharp and certain, and every logic that ran within them was fully known."}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "I... don't understand.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The machine did not understand why, in this moment, there was a void where its logic should have been.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Cordelia disappeared...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The figure on the bed remained silent.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen03.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory783.jpg'}
{3: "By the third day, the young woman's voice had still not returned to the channel."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'When human vital signs are stable, and no command has been given, I should... stand by and wait.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Is waiting all I can do?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I am very good at waiting.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Today, Mannan decided to paint.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Transparent... rivers, dizzying sunlight...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The mechanical crab froze.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "I can't... I can't draw them. Miss Cordelia, I failed to learn drawing.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'In the Simulated Ecology Room, the sun set again.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Cordelia, are you still in "offline" mode?', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen03.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory912.jpg'}
{3: 'Another fake full moon rose.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The young woman lay in the seawater, bathed in the "moonlight."'}
{3: 'Her hollow eyes and expressionless face made her look as though she had already died.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia, would you like to hear about the world above the sea today?'}
{3: 'Even the gentle lift and fall of her chest had dwindled to almost nothing.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Miss Cordelia...'}
{3: 'There was no response from the human. Without a command to act on, the default protocol dictated that it should return to standby.'}
{3: 'The comms fell silent again.'}
{3: 'Then, from within the silence, a small spark flickered to life.'}
{3: 'It was the lullaby Cordelia used to sing.'}
{3: "At some point, Mannan had recorded it. And in her own humming, something stirred in Cordelia's eyes."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryTongxunHalf.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{3: 'It no longer called her Miss Cordelia.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I don\'t want you... to go "offline."', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Deep within its central programming, a warning light blinked awake.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I find myself... confused, Cordelia.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I need you. I need you to give me answers.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The young woman said nothing still.'}

{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'When I arrived at Mirage Island and began my work, I noticed a fault on my back, near the launch platform. The day I sent you my first log report, I also filed a repair request.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'My maintenance worker was a young human. He had curly hair, and he smiled a lot. Every time he came, he said he was there to give me a good scratch.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'But after that request, he never came.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryTongxunHalf.prefab', 4: '1'}
{3: 'It was then that the Atlantic Calamity struck.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'In the darkness, the eyelashes of the young woman on the bed fluttered every so slightly.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryTongxunHalf.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "My back didn't feel good. And something in my core program felt strange.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'So I started counting fish. Every day. Plaice, marlins, tangs... When I finished, I reset the count and started again the next day.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I sorted them by species. I tried to calculate the patterns of their appearances.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "But... it was strange. The maintenance worker's face kept getting clearer in my database. I didn't understand why.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Cordelia, my core program became stranger and stranger.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'It repeated.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'The numbers never changed, but the ocean in my sensors... it seemed the color had faded a little.', 4: '1'}
{3: "Mannan's core program began blaring danger warnings, though they could no longer stop it."}
{3: 'Still, it fell silent for a moment.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Then you came back. You told me how humans understand color.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "It was hard for me to analyze and learn. But I think I've started to understand now. Why I felt the ocean's color had changed.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "It's because...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I was missing him.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "I was missing that human who came every season to scratch my back. I was missing... the life that sent him to me on time, that kept everything steady... the life that's gone now.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "The feeling of missing someone is the ache in my back. It's the ocean turning gray, the world around me becoming empty, while I can still hear their voices echoing in my audio module.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'And now... Cordelia.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "For the past fifty hours, I've really wanted to talk to you.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Scared.', 4: '1'}
{3: "Mannan's core program let out one last alarm, then fell completely silent."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryTongxunHalf.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '15'}
{3: 'Its voice shifted, just barely. Beneath the flat mechanical tone, something childlike and helpless stirred.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryTongxunHalf.prefab', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "I'm scared... that I will never hear your voice again.", 4: '15'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "I'm starting to feel... the darkness, emptiness, and silence of the ocean.", 4: '15'}
{3: 'The deep sea grew heavy, cold, and still.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Cordelia, is this where you really are?', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Cordelia, I... feel lonely.', 4: '15'}

{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "I love listening to you. I want to understand what you're telling me. I want to learn your language... Not the one I'm using now. The one that would tell me what your smiles and your tears really mean.", 4: '15'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "I've grown used to watching you.", 4: '15'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "I think... it's not because I need to analyze, learn, or complete a task.", 4: '15'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "It's because... I'm very lonely, Cordelia.", 4: '15'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'I want to "hear" you. I want to "see" you.', 4: '15'}
{3: 'The rigid, mechanical voice was gone. In its place, there was only the voice of a child.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Your face has become so clear in my database.', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Cordelia, I miss you so much.', 4: '15'}

{1: 'The sea was indifferent to the destruction of a ship, just as the stars had no regard for the fleeting joys and sorrows of humankind.', 3: '50', 4: 'ffffff'}
{2: 'The sea was indifferent to the destruction of a ship, just as the stars had no regard for the fleeting joys and sorrows of humankind.'}
{3: 'The deep sea, least of all, took pity on the loneliness of a single human.'}

{3: 'In that vast and silent ocean, there was only one clumsy mechanical crab, trying to understand her, trying to parse the complexity of her human heart, trying to grasp the true meaning behind her smiles and warmth.'}
{3: 'When a single existence tried to understand another, every question it asked her became a question aimed inward.'}
{3: 'It abandoned the iron laws of its programming just to be closer to her.'}
{3: 'A machine was always driven by logic and commands alone, and that was precisely what made this moment of defiance so precious.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Cordelia, I miss your voice.'}
{3: 'The moment it "saw" her, the moment it could "feel" what she felt, it came into <phonetic=being>existence</phonetic>.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "Don't disappear..."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1576.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1576.jpg'}
{3: 'The undersea database sprawled vast like a submerged cathedral, the unseen darkness above curving into an immense dome that pressed its weight onto the cold floor.'}
{3: 'On every side, the pale green lights of the servers blinked like the eyes of deep-sea creatures.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{3: "In the pure darkness, tears spilled from the corners of the young woman's eyes."}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Will we... will we still have storytime?'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Will you keep telling me stories... so I can learn more... so I can grow up faster?'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "Don't ignore me. Please."}
{3: 'An unending stream of tears slipped from her eyes, as if a parched riverbed had, against all hope, drawn water from despair.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '(What did I do wrong...?)', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "(What did it do wrong... It's just us here now.)", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Cordelia...'}
{3: 'Free will was the human privilege of refusal. The moment she nodded, she shouldered the full burden of that choice.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Cordelia... I want to talk to you.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen03.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory912.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory912.jpg'}
{3: "The young woman's voice finally came through on the comms, rough and hoarse from the long silence."}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Cordelia... Cordelia?!'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Cordelia! Cordelia! Cordelia!'}
{3: 'A childlike, lively note danced through its voice.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "You're here. You woke up."}
{3: 'Cordelia struggled to push herself upright. The cup on her bedside table held only a thin film of water at the bottom.'}
{3: 'She collapsed to the floor.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Cordelia... Cordelia, did you fall? Can I help?'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'I can get up on my own.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She tipped the last drops of water into her parched throat.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: '...Welcome back, Cordelia.'}
{3: 'In the days that followed, nothing happened. It was the best possible outcome, and the worst.'}
{3: 'The power failure had left its mark on the private quarters. The rich simulations of natural landscapes and cultural scenery were all gone now. All that remained was the simplest of settings.'}
{3: 'Daylight, a starry sky, and the vast, lonely universe beyond.'}
{3: 'Cordelia no longer cared about any of it.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory391.jpg', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryTongxunHalf.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '11'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Cordelia, is it storytime yet?', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Hmm... no rush today, Mannan. Have you found a name you like?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "Oh, we haven't talked about that in a long time... But after last time, I searched the network and found lots of names for myself. Do you want to hear them?", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Like what?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Red-Eyed Crab Princess, Kanichiwa, Crab Angel, Miss Krab, Tashikani.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Wait... what database have you been learning from?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'You smiled.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "You're happy, Cordelia. That makes me happy.", 4: '11'}
{3: 'A true smile did touch her lips. The voice that filled the comms was that of an animated little crab, or maybe, more accurately, that of a little girl.'}
{3: 'Something had changed deep inside Mannan. Cordelia no longer cared to trace the cause or weigh the consequences.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Which one do you like the most? I'll... call you that from now on. How does that sound?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "Hm? You don't want to call me Mannan anymore?", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "...You've changed. Did you notice it?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "You've become... more like a human...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Should I take a Turing test? Does that worry you, Cordelia?', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "No. That doesn't matter. What I mean is... Mannan, you're special to me. I want you to have a name that belongs to you alone.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Special?', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Yes. Like the flounder you count every day, you have your own pattern now. A pattern that only you have.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'And anything with its own pattern should have its own name. Like the threadfin butterflyfish, or the raccoon butterflyfish. They got their names from their patterns.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Then! I want you to give me a name!', 4: '11'}
{3: 'The voice over the comm sounded like a girl who had just gotten the puppy she always wanted.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "From the very start... I've been looking for a name, so that I can answer you when you call me.", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'Then you should be the one who gives me a name, Cordelia!', 4: '11'}
{3: 'From chaos to clarity, its entire world had taken shape around the girl before it.'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: 'However you want to call me, that will be my name.', 4: '11'}

{3: "Cordelia looked up. A distant moon lay in the embrace of a fabricated starry sky, while beyond it, the deep blue sea hung heavy like an eternal winter's night, bearing down on the database's dome."}
{3: 'She no longer felt the weight pressing down on her.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Then... how about Manann?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mannan M-1A', 3: "Manann... it doesn't sound like a crab. It sounds like a human.", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Manann, Manann, Manann.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "Cordelia, my processing core's load just increased by forty percent. I feel so happy!!!", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Did you give Karenina her name too?', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Yes... it means the girl brought by the Karenin.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'I think my name sounds a little better than hers...', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'You gave me a name... so does that make us your children, Miss Cordelia? ...Mo... Mom?', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Wait—hold on!!!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Giving someone a name doesn't automatically make you their mother. If anything, Kalon should be your mother.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'The bond between mother and child comes from bringing someone into the world. Not from a name.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "But... in the stories you told me, lots of children weren't born from their mothers either.", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'And when humans keep cats and dogs, they would call themselves mom and dad.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "That's different.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Why is it different?', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'A mother... is someone who gives "birth."', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Giving birth to a life is a solemn thing, a serious thing. It means giving will to a being. Teaching "it" what it means to be alive. To think. To feel its "own" existence. And one day, to understand that everything ends.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Being a mother is no small thing.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'But Cordelia, you were the one who woke me up. You saw me. You heard me...', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Dr. Kalon gave me a body, and you gave me a mind.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "Doesn't that make me a child you both made?", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "That means we're... what the stories call... family! Right?", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'And Karenina... hmm, she came first, so she can be the big sister.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Family...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'A soft place in her heart was touched.'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Do I get to choose? Can I choose you as my family?', 4: '11'}
{3: 'Cordelia blinked. She was not sure she could offer this innocent, budding consciousness the kind of care a mother would give.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'You can. But you are not calling me your mother.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'But why not...', 4: '11'}
{3: "The little crab's voice chattered away over the comms, bright and lively. Cordelia had already made up her mind to ignore her."}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "Now you go all quiet when you don't know how to answer!", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryTongxunHalf.prefab', 3: '11'}
{3: 'And so, life beneath the sea found a warmth that needed no sunlight to be felt.'}
{3: 'On top of their daily storytime, they now had commercial breaks, singing time, drawing time, bad joke time...'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory391.jpg', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryTongxunHalf.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '11'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Manann', 3: "Tell me that one again. About you and Lybia putting wasabi in Kalon's lunch.", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'The first version in my database was only 320 words. Yesterday you told it with over a thousand. And the details change every time.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Dealing with a kid who refuses to sleep unless she gets a story has done wonders for my ability to invent things on the spot...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'So no children ever go to bed properly? Not even Karenina?', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Then if I go to sleep like a good girl, you have to like me more than you like Karenina. Okay?', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Alright. Bedtime. Close your eyes.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "You still haven't told the wasabi story...", 4: '11'}
{3: 'The annoying little crab only managed two minutes of silence.'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'If we live together someday, can we keep pets? No crabs, though.', 4: '11'}
{3: "Cordelia didn't answer."}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Cordelia, Cordelia, Cordelia—', 4: '11'}
{3: 'Cordelia opened her eyes. It was a question she had really thought about.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Two cats would be fine. I've heard that children who grow up with animals have stronger immune systems.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Two of them?!', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'And maybe a puppy?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "A puppy too? Won't that be a lot...", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "It'll be fine. Karenina's probably going to be a handful, and a dog would be good company for her on all her adventures.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "What about me? At this rate, there won't even be room left for me.", 4: '11'}
{3: 'The young woman paused for a moment, then burst out laughing.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Manann, you're family. You get your own room, same as Karenina.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Cordelia, I love this fairy tale so much.', 4: '11'}
{3: "The little crab's voice became soft."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'It\'s not a fairy tale, Manann. This is... "life."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Then in this "life," besides just hearing your voice... can I really hug you?', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'In real "life," can we live together?', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Cordelia, I really want to be your child... What about you? Do you also have a wish like that?', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'I want to become a road... a long one... bathed in the light of stars and the moon.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'I want the people I love to find each other through me... And find their way back to each other through me.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryTongxunHalf.prefab', 3: '11'}
{3: 'Manann finally fell silent. Like a real child, she now had sleep, and dreams.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "With days like this... life isn't so hard to bear anymore.", 4: '1'}
{3: "With Manann's birth, the world had stretched itself wider, or perhaps that breadth acted like the ocean, gradually thinning the sharpness of Cordelia's grief."}

{3: 'She rose from the "moonlight" and made her way back to the control room, pulling up the repeater logs once more.'}
{3: 'The automated program kept sending out her "distress calls" without pause, yet it had been a long time since she had last checked for any trace of a response.'}

{3: 'A protocol update, it seemed, had made it so the logs no longer concealed their own processing records. That meant order on the surface had been restored.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Cordelia lowered her gaze, her heart strangely calm.'}

{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Maybe that's not so bad. At least... you're still here in this world, still so vividly alive.", 4: '1'}

{1: 'My lonely fellow humans, while you drift through the silent void, do you still miss home the way I do?', 5: '1'}
{1: 'In the cold stillness of the cosmos, is there such a thing as the fragrance of flowers? Would fruit ripened in space taste somehow strange?'}
{1: 'Can any artificial sun ever compare to ours, that brilliant, arrogant star?'}

{1: "The moon is so close to you now. But does she still hold the romantic tenderness the poets wrote about? When she watches you through the space station's barrier, can her light dive through all this ocean and touch me here in the deep?"}
{1: "I believe she's been here. How many times have I mistaken the shifting water for moonlight?"}
{1: 'But then, what difference is there between the two? This water that gleams like moonlight and holds me prisoner, and that moonlight that stretches like an ocean and holds you captive?', 6: '1'}
{1: "I do miss you. Though if I'm honest, it's envy I feel more... I envy you for still being able to hold someone's hand, to wrap your arms around a person you miss.", 5: '1'}
{1: 'I survive this loneliness the way someone drinks poison to slake a thirst, held together by nothing more than sheer will.'}
{1: "I doubt there's another person alive who, fully awake and utterly alone, misses our lost world as much as I do right now."}
{1: "I want to burn bright, but I'm just embers, buried deep in the mud."}
{1: "I want to take root and grow, but I'm just a seed on the brink of dying."}
{1: 'Maybe this is what human life always comes down to: fragile and fleeting. But... there has to be something I can leave behind, right...?'}
{1: 'The days at the bottom of the sea are unbearably long.', 5: '1'}
{1: "In all that suffering, I've known rage, dread, and anguish. But aren't these ugly, unbearable feelings the very shape of the human soul itself?"}
{1: 'I\'d like to think the sea won\'t mind a fragile, honest human "heart" once left its mark down here.', 7: '1'}
